svg.title: sparse-nsa
svg.desc: NSA reads three key sets for one query at 64K tokens: about 4,095 compressed records (32-token blocks, stride 16), 16 selected 64-token blocks (1,024 tokens: the first block, 2 local blocks and 13 by score) and a 512-token sliding window, about 5,631 reads or 8.6% of 65,536. Three sigmoid gates mix the branches. Block scores come from the compression attention, summed over the 16 heads of a GQA group, so the group shares one selection. Reported: 9.0× forward and 6.0× backward speedup at 64K versus FlashAttention-2.

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: ot = Σc ∈ {cmp, slc, win} gt c · Attn(qt , Kt c , Vt c )
